The '''Vault of the Tyrant''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] vault in which the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] imprisoned the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] known as [[the Tyrant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The vault was located in the [[Caves of the Primeval Wardens]] in [[the Tomb]].
